summary.headline: Meta opens its models as Wall Street lines up $500B
summary.body: Two big moves pulled in opposite directions. Meta released Muse Glimmer, a roughly 30B open model, and said it will open the weights of its frontier Muse Spark 1.2. Zuckerberg urged the US to remove barriers to open AI. Wider access lowers Power Concentration, lifting Libertarian Utopia and pulling down 1984, Enslaved God and Benevolent Dictator. At the same time, Nvidia and firms including BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, KKR and Blackstone lined up about $500 billion for data centers and fabs. That raises Capability Velocity and concentrates power, lifting Enslaved God, Zookeeper and Descendants. Smaller items: South Australia launched a royal commission on AI, Unitree filed for an IPO, and South Korea set up a chip fund. Horizon Balance improved to -0.36.
summary.movers_note: Libertarian Utopia +0.3, from Meta's open-weights move (+0.38), partly offset by the $500B infrastructure push (-0.12). 1984 -0.3, from Meta's open-weights move (-0.26) and the $500B infrastructure push (-0.03), partly offset by South Australia's royal commission (+0.03). Descendants +0.2, mostly from the $500B infrastructure push (+0.22) and Unitree's IPO filing (+0.04), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.06).

events.title: Meta releases open-weight Muse Glimmer, will open Muse Spark 1.2
events.summary: Meta released a ~30B open model for local agents and said it will open its frontier Muse Spark 1.2 weights; Zuckerberg urged the US to remove barriers to open AI and pledged $1B for data-center community concerns.
events.reason: Strong open-weights push from a major lab.

events.title: Nvidia and Wall Street firms line up ~$500B for AI infrastructure
events.summary: Nvidia partnered with BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, KKR, Blackstone and others to raise about $500 billion for data centers and fabs.
events.reason: Huge capital pool for compute concentrated around Nvidia.

events.title: South Australia launches royal commission into AI
events.summary: South Australia announced a royal commission on artificial intelligence; NSW floated ending unsupervised take-home assessments over generative AI.

events.title: Unitree files for ~$904M Shanghai IPO
events.summary: Hangzhou robot maker Unitree is seeking about 6.1 billion yuan in a Shanghai listing, with over 40% of 2025 revenue from overseas.

events.title: South Korea sets up 5 trillion won chip supply-chain fund; TSMC July sales up 45%
events.summary: Seoul launched a ~$3.5B fund for chip materials, equipment and fabless design; TSMC reported July revenue up about 45% and raised its outlook on AI demand.
events.reason: Asian chip capacity expanding for AI.
